description: Multitouch digitizer frame listener, private MultitouchSupport dynamic linkage, 2.5mm edge boundary, top 30% entry zone, 3.0mm deadzone, and corner tap dispatching.
Dual volume architecture switching between CoreAudio system sound master level and WebKit/AVPlayer internal gain.
Volume scalar conversion, step increments, and mute state toggling.
Target -14 LUFS loudness normalizer calculation and 250ms cosine volume easing transitions.
CoreAudio kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultOutputDevice hardware listener triggering safety auto-pause on headphone/AirPod disconnect.
AVFoundation AVPlayer pipeline for local high-fidelity audio playback (FLAC, MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A, AIFF, OGG, OPUS).
Extraction of ID3, Vorbis, and MP4 tags and embedded album art via AVMetadataItem.
Multi-tier lyrics orchestrator: local .lrc files -> local disk cache -> YouTube Music InnerTube -> LRCLib API -> plain text fallback.
Parser for .lrc timestamp lines [mm:ss.xx], UTF-8 decoding, tag extraction ([ti:], [ar:], [offset:]), and timestamp lookup.
Floating borderless NSPanel positioned under the display notch or top menu bar displaying synchronized live lyrics.
Orchestrator for offline audio downloads, child process management with yt-dlp, and destination storage at ~/Music/Mooziac/.
Automated standalone binary manager for yt-dlp placed in ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/bin/.
Recursive directory scanner, file watcher, and library importer for local music directories.
SQLite storage manager maintaining cached_tracks, playlists, playlist_items, listening_history, and liked_songs.
Native pure-Swift Unix domain socket IPC client (/tmp/discord-ipc-0) for Discord Rich Presence under application ID 1537169013174435870.
macOS MPNowPlayingInfoCenter and MPRemoteCommandCenter bridge for system media controls and hardware keys.
NSStatusItem controller in the macOS menu bar, volume scroll accumulator (6pt trackpad = 2%, discrete notch = 4%), and quick menu.
Theme engine providing OLED Dark Mode (#000000), Adaptive ambient glow, Pure Crystal Glass, and Watery Transparent modes.
Implementations of Waveform (32-bar reactive wave), Neon Glow, Cyber Dots, and Minimal Line progress scrubbers.
WebKit container for YouTube Music, desktop Safari user-agent override for Google authentication, and JavaScript bridge hooks.
Interactive queue drawer with drag-and-drop NSTableView reordering, shuffle, repeat, and queue clearing.
In-window keyboard shortcuts dispatcher with first-responder check to avoid intercepting Space in web input text fields.
System-wide background hotkey registration using Carbon/CoreGraphics event hooks (Cmd+Opt+Space).
GitHub releases API integration for checking available updates and prompting user download.
Application lifecycle, activation policy toggling for Menu Bar Only mode, and background playback preservation on window close.
Swift Package Manager definition confirming macOS 13.0+ minimum target and zero third-party package dependencies.
Automated build shell script producing Universal 2 binaries (arm64 and x86_64) and packaging dist/Mooziac.app.
Primary user documentation, feature summary, Gatekeeper bypass instructions (xattr -cr), memory benchmarks, and architecture highlights.
Detailed version history from v1.0.0 through v1.1.7, recording fixes for macOS 27 beta contrast, status bar scroll volume, and spacebar in search.
Privacy policy and security model: zero telemetry, zero analytics SDKs, local-first SQLite persistence.
Complete uninstallation guide listing all filesystem paths for application support, caches, and preference plists.
Official marketing site showcasing features, trackpad gestures, OLED and adaptive modes, and download links.
User support tickets and issue submissions regarding download errors, lyrics matching, and gatekeeper alerts.
GitHub issue tracker recording fixed bugs (#5 spacebar search, #6 menu bar scroll) and open requests (#2 hotkeys GUI, #3 playlist export, #4 OLED accent).
Public community discussions on Mooziac memory efficiency, trackpad edge gesture ergonomics, and comparison with Spotify desktop.
